cause: Two independently spawned fixtures awaited the same number of physics events but accumulated different player-local commit stamps before the idle frame. The foreign-motor test assumed equal stamps and failed its positive setup control.
patch_scope: Only the fixture's foreign-motor setup: a fresh production-player motor receives the exact required stamp from MotorStepProbe in a real physics callback. No production ownership guard, movement rule or assertion is weakened.
acceptance_status: Superseding final GUT and MCP gates are required after the fixture patch; these failed controls are retained, not acceptance retries.
